related.text: Cinema Studio 上线：用 3D 先锁场景/机位/POV，再交给 GPT-6 Astra + Seedance 2.5 渲染，解决「好看却不是那一镜」。
related.text_zh: Cinema Studio 上线：用 3D 先锁场景/机位/POV，再交给 GPT-6 Astra + Seedance 2.5 渲染，解决「好看却不是那一镜」。
related.text_en:
Cinema Studio is live.

AI video has a control problem. You get a stunning shot, but never THE shot.

3D fixes that. Build the scene → set the camera → record the POV → render with AI.

Built for VFX, previs, and game studios. Powered by GPT-6 Astra + Seedance 2.5.
related.why: Astra+Seedance 可控 AI 视频管线，贴合 AI 视频兴趣

related.author: Bishal Nandi (@LearnWithBishal)
related.text: AI 视频与 3D 不再割裂：Astra 编几何 → Blender → Clay Renderer → Dreamina Seedance 2.5 成片。
related.text_zh: AI 视频与 3D 不再割裂：Astra 编几何 → Blender → Clay Renderer → Dreamina Seedance 2.5 成片。
related.text_en:
AI video and 3D used to feel like separate worlds.
Now the workflow looks more like this:

Turns out GPT-6 Astra + Dreamina Seedance 2.5 is an actual pipeline.

Astra codes the geometry → Blender → Clay Renderer Plugin → final render on Dreamina.
related.why: Astra×Seedance 生产流继续刷屏

related.author: Antonio Costa | IA (@xetgepete)
related.text: Dreamina+Seedance 出底片，再让 Astra 操 After Effects 做动效——工具各司其职的 AI 后期流。
related.text_zh: Dreamina+Seedance 出底片，再让 Astra 操 After Effects 做动效——工具各司其职的 AI 后期流。
related.text_en:
And it actually made sense as a workflow.
Dreamina + Seedance 2.5 → generate the base footage.

Then:

GPT-6 Astra → understand the task
After Effects → build the animation/effects
Astra → operate the software
AE → render the result

The cool part is that each tool has a clear job.
related.why: Astra 操 AE：AI 视频+动效交叉

related.author: Arcane Matrix | AI (@Handllex)
related.text: Dreamina/Seedance 2.5 批量出片，挑强片段交给 GPT-6 Astra 在 Premiere 收尾。
related.text_zh: Dreamina/Seedance 2.5 批量出片，挑强片段交给 GPT-6 Astra 在 Premiere 收尾。
related.text_en:
Several video ideas can be generated in Dreamina with Seedance 2.5, then the strongest clips can be passed to GPT-6 Astra to finish in Premiere.

The workflow looks like this:
Dreamina → create multiple affordable variations
Astra → bring the selected footage into Premiere
related.why: Seedance 变体 + Astra 剪辑收尾

related.author: Sally Stockholm (@aiwithsally)
related.text: 视频生成已过「逼真」门槛：现在看的是控制力——Veo 写实+音频、Kling 运动等各有所长。
related.text_zh: 视频生成已过「逼真」门槛：现在看的是控制力——Veo 写实+音频、Kling 运动等各有所长。
related.text_en:
Video generation has crossed a weird line.

I used to think the impressive part was making a realistic clip from a prompt.

Now almost every serious model can do that.

What I’m watching instead is how much control we’re getting:

Veo for realism + audio.
Kling for motion.
related.why: AI 视频赛道从画质转向可控性

Talk to Siri, and it can take actions those apps make available through App Intents.
